QUESTIONS

FAQ

How much does one product cost?

Every NEON ULTRAS design costs 199 DH, whichever club or crest you choose.

What is included in the package?

The premium neon LED artwork, the battery, a free sticker pack and double-sided adhesive for installation.

Does the product come with a battery?

Yes. The battery is included, so your artwork is ready to light up straight out of the box.

Is installation difficult?

No. Use the double-sided adhesive included in the package and put your artwork directly on the wall. No tools, no complicated setup.

Can I pay when my order arrives?

Yes. Payment is Cash on Delivery: you pay when you receive your order.

How do I place an order?

Pick your design, enter your name, Moroccan phone number and delivery address, choose the quantity and press “Confirm my order”. No account needed.

How can I contact NEON ULTRAS?

Use the WhatsApp button or the social links in the footer below.
